surface: browser-local recent searches on the canonical Search document

states.empty: The bare Search document with nothing remembered. Before and after are the same page: an empty history is quiet and adds no heading, control, or space.
states.populated: Back on /search/ after searching rats and then CB3. After adds one compact list under the unchanged search action, newest first, each entry a link to its canonical Search URL with its own remove control.
states.storage-unavailable: A rats results page whose browser refuses local storage. Before and after are the same page: no history renders and the results, coverage receipt and search action are untouched.
